item8_QUOTATIONS_SECTION77.myMETHOD: I did NOT use a raw substring search. I folded, in both haystack and needle: em/en dashes to '--', curly quotes to straight, ellipsis characters, then BLOCKQUOTE MARKERS (leading '>'), LIST BULLETS ('-', '*', '+' and 'N.'), TABLE PIPES, TRAILING BACKSLASHES, and markdown emphasis/code marks -- and only then collapsed whitespace. Section 7.7 is explicit that whitespace normalisation ALONE still returns ABSENT on its own most load-bearing sentence because it is set as a blockquote, so folding structure is not optional. I loaded 536 sources: every .md at the coop root and every .json and .py under artifacts/, excluding the subject itself so that a fabricated quotation cannot be present in the file that fabricated it.

reviewerStatement: I set out to reject this. The dispatch named five places a blocker would live and I went to all five with my own instruments. The derivation resolves clean through both links under the corpus's own resolver and the effective contract differs from its predecessor at exactly the 6 leaf positions and 2 operation targets published, verified by a type-exact deep diff I wrote. The zero-operation trap is real: I read `bool(value)` in check-completeness.py's live source and then executed an empty operation list, and the resolver silently sees no derivation and appends no error -- the subject chose the visible shape when the invisible one was easier. The defect is real: 'The retained checker is itself unreviewed' is false of a file the corpus grades REJECT FOR REPAIR, its restatement at knownLimitationsV4[7] names no file and a grep misses it, and after resolution the false predicate is asserted at 2 leaves of v4 and 0 leaves of v5. The reproduction is real: my driver, my scratch tree, the published mutation digest to the character, and check-delivery-v4.py green on bytes carrying the text its own version repaired.
